## Summary

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would change existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation / chore (no runtime changes)

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `ruff check jobapply tests`, `black --check jobapply tests`, and `mypy jobapply` locally.
- [ ] I ran `pytest` and all tests pass (or I've explained why not).
- [ ] I updated `CHANGELOG.md` if this PR affects user-visible behavior.
- [ ] I updated the README / docs if I added or renamed any CLI flags or config keys.
- [ ] I have **not** committed any API keys, `profile.json`, `profile.md`, or `output/`.
